1.w: To your mouth [set] the shofar, as an eagle over the house of YHWH, because they have transgressed My covenant, and against My law they have rebelled.

2.w: To Me they cry, “O My God, Israel, we know You.”

3.w: Israel has rejected the good; an enemy will pursue him.

4.w: They set up kings, and not from Me; they made princes, and not ones I knew. With their silver and gold they made for themselves idols, that it might be cut off.

5.w: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria; My anger burns against them. Until when will they not be capable of innocence?

6.w: For it [is] from Israel. A workman made it, and it [is] not God. Surely the calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.

7.w: For the wind they sow and they shall reap the whirlwind. The stalk [is] not unto it, a shoot not yielding flour; even if it should produce, strangers would swallow it up!

8.w: Israel is swallowed up; now they are among the Gentiles, like a vessel with no delight in it.

9.w: For they have gone up to Assyria; a wild donkey isolated by himself; Ephraim, they have hired lovers.

10.w: Even though they have hired among the nations, I will now gather them. And they will begin to diminish from the burden of the king of princes.

11.w: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, they have become unto him altars for sinning.

12.w: Were I to write for him the myriad [things] of My law, they would be regarded as a strange thing.

13.w: The sacrifices of My gifts they sacrifice, [and] the flesh they eat—YHWH does not accept them. Now He has in mind their iniquity, and He will attend to their sins: They will return to Egypt.

14.w: And Israel has forgotten his Maker and has built palaces, and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; and I will send fire upon his cities, and it will devour his palaces.
